note: One voice-over, sentence by sentence. `show` is what appears on screen and what every cue in build.mjs chains to; `say` is the same line respelled for the Indonesian TTS (English words written the way they are said). `role`: char = the kreator is talking (his mouth moves), narr = the narrator. `pause` = silence after the line, seconds.
